scope: read-only local caption burn-in runtime capability audit
findings: The active ffmpeg 8.1 build exposes neither the subtitles/libass filter nor the drawtext/freetype filter.
No alternate system ffmpeg, ImageMagick executable or installed Node image-rendering package is available.
Chromium exists, but introducing a browser process as a production media compositor would be a new operational dependency and is not a surgical caption-filter change.
decision: Do not claim caption burn-in and do not add an unreviewed browser compositor. Preserve the byte-backed composition implementation, record the runtime dependency gap, and continue unrelated safe local backlog work.
requiredResolution: Deploy or package a reviewed ffmpeg build with subtitles/libass or drawtext/freetype support, then add pixel-difference and non-Latin caption tests before production qualification.
